fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend. Joshua 12:6 says Moses and the Israelites struck the kings down and the land was given "…as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh." The text calls Moses "…the servant of the LORD…" and says nothing about him keeping any of it. The land goes to those three groups. Nobody's holding the whole batch for himself here.

Close, friend, but not quite. Joshua and the Israelites did conquer those kings, and that part is true. But the text says Joshua gave the land as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, "according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel…" (Joshua 12:7). So he won it and handed it out. It doesn't say he kept it under his own rule.
